slides.headline: Ocean Drive car-free winter gets 7-0 vote
slides.body: Miami Beach commissioners voted 7-0 to seek an annual car closure from 5th to 15th streets, Thanksgiving through March 31.

photo.query: Ocean Drive Miami Beach Lummus Park Art Deco hotels
photo.prompt: Wide daytime photo of Ocean Drive beside Lummus Park with Art Deco hotels, palm trees and traffic lanes visible

slides.headline: That follows traffic changes since 2020
slides.body: Ocean Drive closed to cars in 2020 for outdoor dining and distancing, then reopened to cars on January 24, 2022.

photo.query: Ocean Drive Miami Beach outdoor dining pandemic
photo.prompt: Street-level view of Ocean Drive with outdoor dining tables, pedestrians and Art Deco buildings along the curb

slides.headline: And 2025 brought two-way traffic back
slides.body: In February 2025, Miami Beach reopened Ocean Drive to two-way traffic and removed the bike lanes.

photo.query: Ocean Drive Miami Beach traffic cars Art Deco
photo.prompt: Low-angle photo of cars moving both directions on Ocean Drive with Art Deco hotels and pedestrians on the sidewalk

slides.headline: So winter would mean walking 10 blocks
slides.body: The proposed closure covers Ocean Drive from 5th to 15th streets on the Lummus Park side, where hotels and sidewalk cafes line the street.

photo.query: Lummus Park Ocean Drive Miami Beach pedestrians
photo.prompt: Crowds walking along Ocean Drive beside Lummus Park, with palm trees, sidewalk cafes and Art Deco hotel fronts

slides.headline: Which splits Ocean Drive businesses
slides.body: Some businesses say closures help foot traffic. Others say they hurt hotel access and push congestion onto parallel streets.

photo.query: Ocean Drive Miami Beach sidewalk cafes hotels
photo.prompt: Busy Ocean Drive sidewalk cafe scene with hotel entrances, pedestrians, valet area and traffic nearby

slides.headline: So county and FDOT decide next
slides.body: Miami-Dade County and FDOT still have to review and permit the closure before the annual plan can begin.
